task.description: WF-02, step 5b, gate pass 3 of 3 - TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR re-checks the tests of run M1CODE-20261119-01 at the tag base/M1CODE-20261119-01-review5 after fix round 02d/02e and test rework 05i (decisions/0124 О32-О39), against the pass-2 PASS (step-05h, lows T7, T8).

summary: Verdict PASS: no finding of severity high or medium. Four Low findings (T9, T10, T11, T12) are recorded; none blocks. Checked in fresh clones of the tag base/M1CODE-20261119-01-review5 (63e92a9) under <scratch>; the project tree ran nothing (its git status at the end is the same two lines as at the start, git diff of app and tools against HEAD is empty; the tag differs from the project HEAD 8ea5862 only in records, `git diff --stat base/M1CODE-20261119-01-review5 HEAD -- app tools` is empty).

Own runs: `cd app && npm run check` exit 0: unit 120/120, int 47/47, skipped 0, todo 0. `npm run test:e2e` twice: 15 of 15, skipped 0, todo 0, exit 0 both times (420.3 s and 414.5 s). Criterion grep of REQ-108 criterion 2 (SELECTOR_GREP of npmrc.test.js as grep -rnE over app/test): no line, exit 1. No xit/xtest/xdescribe and no path of this computer in app/test. The 18 test files named by the guards exist: NPM-5 (12 int + 2 pg), NM-5 (25 unit), NPM-7 (2 e2e files, 15 tests) and NM-6 are green in the check.

Mutants: 61 of my own (see `mutants`): server demo.js id() and text() (14), the no-match texts (7), the snapshot helper (9), the own-row media query and the speaker geometry (17), the chip names (9), the live line (5). Survivors that are findings: M04, M07, M11, M14 (T9), E06, E07 (T10), C08 (T11), L04 (T12); E10-E12 are equal in effect (the own row has room, nothing overflows). All the mutants that the fix round and the rework were made for are red: non-string question and option ids (M01-M03, M05, M06, M08-M10), the no-match texts in ru, kk, en (I01-I07), the chip name missing, reversed, without the colon, duplicated or without «Не знаю» (C01-C07, C09), the media query at 359, 370, 371, 372, 375, 378, 400 px (E01-E05, E08, E09, E17), the title wider than its column at 360-379 px (E13, E14, E16), the live line not emptied (L01-L03, L05 finishes in 18 s, no hang), the snapshot sort, directories, bytes and recursion (S01-S09: T8 of pass 2 is closed).

Pass-2 lows: T7 closed (L01 red in LD-8 after the switch to kk, with the wait for the en announcement first); T8 closed (S01 red in VB-6 with the top-level z.txt). T4 (counts of the design's section 10) is ORCH's and not touched here.

Nothing weakened against base/M1CODE-20261119-01-5b2: test( 9/9 (landing), 8/8 (demo int), 6 to 7 (intake: IN-7 added), 7/7, 6/6; assert. 118 to 121, 135 to 131 (demo int), 47 to 48, 160/160, 62/62. The removed lines of the whole diff are only: the `unwritable` row of DM-6c (five assertions: the 503 pair, no 500 in the log, the logged code, health, 404) and the clause of its title, the title/JSDoc lines that were rewritten, and the lines of VB-6 that now carry base[3]. DM-6c gained one assertion per row and way (no Kazakh letters in the 503 body); it cannot turn red alone because the preceding deepEqual pins the whole body (a redundancy, not a finding).

Stability: the e2e series ran twice green and the changed unit and int files ran green on the tag in the check; the new wait (T7 in LD-8) is a condition with a 15 s deadline; L05 shows a missing line gives a red in 18 s, not a hang. The mutant files finished in every case (the DM-6c mutants M01-M13 each end in under a minute).

Why T9 is only Low: with the guard id(s.id) of the result route removed (M07), an object or array solution id still gives 503, because the engine looks the id up in a Map by identity and throws (confirmed by a probe: object id with rules following the same object throws demo_unavailable); so DM-6c rows 5 and 6 pass without the guard and do not test it. The reachable form is a primitive id (number, true, null) with rules naming the same value: without the guard the route answers 200 with ids [7,7,7] (probe, <scratch> script). No text can be smuggled in that way, so there is no leak; it is a gap of what the rows claim.

findings.where: app/test/int/demo.test.js DM-6c rows 'a solution id that is an object/array holding a Kazakh text'; server/routes/demo.js id(), text()
findings.what: The two solution-id rows do not test the guard id(s.id): mutants M07 and M11 (guard removed, or skipped in en) leave DM-6c green, because an object or array solution id never reaches the answer anyway (the engine's Map lookup throws on the rules). A non-string primitive is not tried anywhere: M04 (id() lets number, boolean and null through) and M14 (text() lets number and null through) stay green; with the solution-id guard removed an intake with numeric solution ids and rules naming them answers 200 with id 7.
findings.fix: Add rows: a question id and an option id that are a number, true and null (questionnaire, ru en kk, both ways); an intake in which every solution id and every rule.solution is the number 7 (resp. true, null) so that the id reaches the result route; a text (title, summary) that is a number or null. Keep the object and array rows for the question and option ids; fix the comments/titles of the solution rows so they do not claim 'id copied whole' for objects.

findings.what: The own-row threshold is pinned from below (359 to 378 are red) but only loosely from above: max-width 380 and 389 (E06, E07) stay green, because no width between 379 and 390 is read. The decision О36 says below 380 px, so a threshold of 380-389 px is a different rule that passes (known to TEST-DESIGNER as I2).
findings.fix: Add 380 px (and 389 px) to the widths of section F with the side-by-side expectation (the speaker beside «Назад», not over it); the e2e count stays 15.

findings.what: О37 says the chip keeps only aria-label and the title that repeats the question is dropped. Mutant C08 (title restored next to the aria-label) stays green: LD-6 reads the accessible name only.
findings.fix: In LD-6 add for each chip `assert.equal(await chip.getAttribute('title'), null)` (or drop the decision's item); optional.

findings.what: Mutant L04 (spoken += 1 removed from setLang) stays green: a pending announcement (30 ms after a tap) that fires after a language switch writes the old-language line; no test taps and switches in one task, and the T7 wait in LD-8 removes the race on purpose. Pass 2 noted the same (E03/E19 class); the claim 'the live line is emptied on a switch' is pinned, 'and no old line arrives later' is not.
findings.fix: In LD-8: in one page.evaluate click an answer and then the language button, then wait a conditional 15 s for #live and a further ANNOUNCE_MS+100 ms and assert #live is still empty.
